highlights.title: mlforge-mlops
highlights.desc: Production credit risk continuous delivery: Feast feature store, DVC pipelines, MLflow model registry, and automated KS/PSI distribution drift monitoring.

highlights.title: documind-rag
highlights.desc: Enterprise document RAG chatbot: sentence-window chunking, hybrid dense + BM25 Okapi retrieval, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), cross-encoder reranking, and citation verification.

highlights.title: cropguard-agri-ai
highlights.desc: Edge Agri-AI crop disease classifier (38 PlantVillage classes): ONNX Runtime quantization (16.1 MB, 2.1 ms), temperature scaling ECE calibration (0.0257), and Laplacian blur gate.

highlights.title: urdunlp-toolkit
highlights.desc: Low-resource NLP toolkit for Urdu and Roman Urdu: multi-stage normalization (-15.26% vocabulary reduction), Jaccard anti-leakage splitting, and calibrated sentiment triage.

highlights.title: trendcast-forecasting
highlights.desc: Pakistan food commodity time-series forecasting: real WFP price series (2004–2026), rolling-origin backtesting, calibrated residual prediction intervals (81.8% PICP), and baseline comparison gate.

highlights.title: Frugal-ML-Extension
highlights.desc: Food demand forecasting regressor and shelf-life spoilage hazard classifier microservice for the Frugal sustainable food distribution platform.
